hooks.command: echo '\n[coderabbit auto-delegation] The submitted prompt looks like CodeRabbit review content. The main agent should auto-delegate to the coderabbit-fixer subagent WITHOUT waiting for /fix-coderabbit. Dispatcher protocol: group comments by target file; for EACH file acquire a per-file lock via `bash .claude/lib/session-lock.sh acquire cr-fixer:<file-sha1-12> $CLAUDE_SESSION_ID --note <path>` BEFORE spawning — if acquire fails (exit 2) another window owns it, skip with a deferring note. Spawn one coderabbit-fixer per file with run_in_background:true (parallel Agent calls in one message when several), each paired with a Monitor on `bash .claude/scripts/agent-progress-monitor.sh <output_file>`, passing CR_LOCK_KEY + CR_SESSION_ID so the fixer releases its lock on exit. Forward same-file comments to a live fixer via SendMessage. Track every spawn in the in-flight registry and surface the ## In-flight block each turn while any fixer is alive. Apply SAFE fixes automatically, surface STRUCTURAL via AskUserQuestion, ALWAYS halt on branch-intent regions. See .claude/agents/coderabbit-fixer.md and .claude/commands/fix-coderabbit.md.'
